title: Angle Bisector
description: An angle bisector divides an angle into two equal angles.

example.question: Construct the bisector of a 70° angle.

note: Constructed using a compass and ruler.

title: Perpendicular Bisector
description: A perpendicular bisector divides a line segment into two equal parts at right angles.

example.question: Construct the perpendicular bisector of a 10 cm line segment.
example.solution: The midpoint is at 5 cm and the bisector forms a 90° angle.

note: Every point on the bisector is equidistant from the endpoints.

title: Copy an Angle
description: Constructs an angle equal to a given angle using a compass.

example.question: Construct an angle equal to 55°.
example.solution: Using a compass, copy the angle to obtain another 55° angle.

title: Parallel Line
description: Constructs a line parallel to a given line through a given point.

example.question: Construct a line parallel to AB through point P.
example.solution: Copy the corresponding angle using a compass.

title: Perpendicular Line
description: Constructs a line perpendicular to a given line.

example.question: Construct a perpendicular to line AB through point P.
example.solution: The constructed line forms a 90° angle with AB.

note: Performed using a compass and ruler.
